templates.datapack.init:
scoreboard objectives add mcs_math dummy "Minecraft-Script Math"
scoreboard objectives add mcs_click {{clickScoreboardCriterion}} "Minecraft-Script Click"

function {{datapack_id}}:user_functions/init
templates.datapack.kill:
function {{datapack_id}}:user_functions/kill

scoreboard objectives remove mcs_math
scoreboard objectives remove mcs_click
data remove storage mcs_click id

datapack disable "file/{{datapackName}}"
templates.literal.set_to_current: data modify storage {{destStorage}} current set from storage {{storage}} {{nbt}}
templates.literal.list.element: data modify storage {{storage}} {{nbt}}.{{index}} set from storage {{srcStorage}} current
templates.variable.declare: data modify storage {{ownerStorage}} variable.{{name}} set from storage {{valueStorage}} {{valueNbt}}
templates.variable.assign: data modify storage {{ownerStorage}} variable.{{name}} set from storage {{valueStorage}} {{valueNbt}}
templates.control.for.macro: $data modify storage {{loopStorage}} variable.{{elementName}} set from storage {{iterableStorage}} {{iterableNbt}}.$(index)
templates.control.code_block:
data modify storage {{childStorage}} variable set from storage {{parentStorage}} variable
function {{datapack_id}}:{{blockPath}}
templates.control.entity_selector: data modify storage {{childStorage}} variable set from storage {{parentStorage}} variable
templates.function.call.param:
data modify storage {{localStorage}} current set from storage {{argStorage}} {{argNbt}}
data modify storage {{localStorage}} variable.{{paramName}} set from storage {{localStorage}} current
templates.builtin.range.init:
data modify storage {{resultStorage}} {{resultNbt}}.length set from storage {{boundStorage}} {{boundNbt}}
function {{datapack_id}}:{{recursivePath}}
templates.builtin.range.recursive:
data modify storage {{recursiveStorage}} current set value {}
function {{datapack_id}}:{{setIndexPath}} with storage {{recursiveStorage}} current
templates.builtin.raycast_block.setup: data modify storage {{ctxStorage}} current set from storage {{rangeStorage}} {{rangeNbt}}

pack.description: This datapack was generated using Minecraft-Script

datapack.main_click_hook: execute as @a at @s if score @s {{scoreboardClick}} matches 1.. run function {{datapack_id}}:clickable_items/check

if.evaluate: execute store result score .out {{scoreboardMath}} run data get storage {{exprStorage}} {{exprNbt}} 1
if.copy_variables: data modify storage {{branchStorage}} variable set from storage {{parentStorage}} variable
if.run_branch: execute if score .out {{scoreboardMath}} matches 1 run function {{datapack_id}}:{{branchPath}}
if.return_on_match: execute if score .out {{scoreboardMath}} matches 1 run return 0

for.init_end: execute store result score .loop_end_{{loopId}} {{scoreboardMath}} run data get storage {{iterableStorage}} {{iterableNbt}}.length 1
for.body_index: execute store result storage {{loopStorage}} current.index int 1 run scoreboard players get .loop_iter_{{loopId}} {{scoreboardMath}}

while.evaluate: execute store result score .out {{scoreboardMath}} run data get storage {{condStorage}} {{condNbt}} 1
while.loop_continue: execute if score .out {{scoreboardMath}} matches 1 run function {{datapack_id}}:{{loopPath}}

async_while.evaluate: execute store result score .out {{scoreboardMath}} run data get storage {{condStorage}} {{condNbt}} 1
async_while.run_body: execute if score .out {{scoreboardMath}} matches 1 run function {{datapack_id}}:{{loopPath}}

math.load_a: execute store result score .a {{scoreboardMath}} run data get storage {{leftStorage}} {{leftNbt}}
math.load_b: execute store result score .b {{scoreboardMath}} run data get storage {{rightStorage}} {{rightNbt}}
math.load_unary: execute store result score .a {{scoreboardMath}} run data get storage {{rootStorage}} {{rootNbt}}
math.store_binary_result: execute store result storage {{resultStorage}} {{resultNbt}} int 1 run scoreboard players get .out {{scoreboardMath}}
math.store_unary_result: execute store result storage {{resultStorage}} {{resultNbt}} int 1 run scoreboard players get .out {{scoreboardMath}}

append.load_length: execute store result score .temp {{scoreboardMath}} run data get storage {{listStorage}} {{listNbt}}.length
append.store_length: execute store result storage {{listStorage}} {{listNbt}}.length int 1 run scoreboard players get .temp {{scoreboardMath}}

range.init_max: execute store result score .range_max_{{scoreboardId}} {{scoreboardMath}} run data get storage {{boundStorage}} {{boundNbt}}
range.index_from_current: execute store result storage {{recursiveStorage}} current.index int 1 run scoreboard players get .range_current_{{scoreboardId}} {{scoreboardMath}}

raycast_block.unless_block: execute unless block ~ ~ ~ #{{datapack_id}}:no_collision run scoreboard players operation .raycast_iter_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}} = .raycast_end_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}}
raycast_block.continue: execute if score .raycast_iter_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}} < .raycast_end_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}} positioned ^ ^ ^0.5 run function {{datapack_id}}:{{loopPath}}
raycast_block.store_end: execute store result score .raycast_end_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}} run data get storage {{ctxStorage}} current 2
raycast_block.anchored_run: execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^.00001 run function {{datapack_id}}:{{loopPath}}

raycast_entity.detect_entity: execute positioned ~-0.1 ~-0.1 ~-0.1 as @e[tag=!raycast_{{raycastId}}, dx=0] positioned ~-0.7 ~-0.7 ~-0.7 if entity @s[dx=0] run scoreboard players operation .raycast_iter_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}} = .raycast_end_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}}
raycast_entity.hit_run: execute if score .raycast_iter_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}} >= .raycast_end_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}} positioned ~-0.1 ~-0.1 ~-0.1 as @e[tag=!raycast_{{raycastId}}, dx=0] positioned ~-0.7 ~-0.7 ~-0.7 at @s run function {{datapack_id}}:user_functions/{{hitFunction}}
raycast_entity.continue: execute if block ~ ~ ~ #{{datapack_id}}:no_collision if score .raycast_iter_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}} < .raycast_end_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}} positioned ^ ^ ^0.5 run function {{datapack_id}}:{{loopPath}}
raycast_entity.store_end: execute store result score .raycast_end_{{raycastId}} {{scoreboardMath}} run data get storage {{ctxStorage}} current 2
raycast_entity.anchored_run: execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^.00001 run function {{datapack_id}}:{{loopPath}}
